subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young male swordsman whose upper-body appearance comes from <Picture 1>, with short dark hair and a black martial-arts robe.
<Subject 2> is the young female swordswoman whose upper-body appearance comes from <Picture 2>, with a high ponytail and a pale-blue robe.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> dueling with swords in a dense green bamboo forest over fifteen seconds. They face off, clash repeatedly, and separate into a final standoff, with their appearances following <Picture 1> and <Picture 2> throughout.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the young male swordsman's short dark hair, black martial-arts robe, and upper-body appearance from <Picture 1> are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the young female swordswoman's high ponytail, pale-blue robe, and upper-body appearance from <Picture 2> are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a cinematic live-action wuxia style with dappled light filtering through tall green bamboo and a slightly desaturated palette.
[Shot 1] A medium-wide shot frames <Subject 1>, the young male swordsman with short dark hair and a black martial-arts robe from <Picture 1>, standing on a narrow earthen path between bamboo trunks, a straight sword with a dark-lacquered grip held low at his side, the blade mostly extending beyond the frame edges. <Subject 2>, the young female swordswoman with a high ponytail and a pale-blue robe from <Picture 2>, stands about six meters away facing him, her slim sword leveled at her waist. Bamboo leaves drift between them as wind bends the upper stalks; both fighters hold still for a beat. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, narrowing on <Subject 1>'s narrowed eyes.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to a medium shot as <Subject 2> launches forward with a burst of speed, robe flaring, and swings her sword in a wide arc toward <Subject 1>. He sidesteps and meets the blade; the two edges clash with a sharp metallic ring and a few sparks. The camera shakes strongly for a moment as they press against each other, <Subject 2> driving <Subject 1> back two steps across the loose bamboo leaves, trunks sliding past in the background.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a fast tracking shot that arcs around the pair at large amplitude as they exchange a rapid sequence of slashes, parries, and footwork, blades ringing repeatedly and slicing through hanging leaves that scatter into the air. <Subject 1> ducks a horizontal cut, spins, and slashes low while <Subject 2> vaults onto a bent bamboo stalk, pushes off, and brings her sword down in an overhead strike that he catches with his blade at the last instant. The camera arcs behind them, catching the two blurred figures and the flying leaf fragments.
[Shot 4] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts to a close two-shot as the fighting slows into a locked-blade exchange, their faces close together with the crossed swords between them, breath misting in the cool air. <Subject 2> twists her wrist, disengages the blades, and spins past <Subject 1>, her ponytail whipping around. He turns to pursue, then stops as she halts a few meters away.
[Shot 5] At 00:13.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot of <Subject 2>, facing the camera, her sword lowered with the tip near the ground, bamboo leaves settling around her as she takes a slow, controlled breath; <Subject 1> stands in the background with his sword lowered, both figures framed upright among the bamboo as the shot holds to the end of the video.

overall_soundscape:
Wind rustles through dense bamboo leaves throughout the video, layered with the sharp metallic ring of clashing blades, the swish of robes cutting through the air, rapid footsteps on packed earth, and scattered snapping sounds of bamboo underfoot.

non_diegetic_music:
Driving taiko war-drum rhythms at a fast tempo with tense guzheng strings, building during the clashes and ending on a single low drum boom as the fighters stop.
